[SWS_PER_00395]
⌈
When an existing file of a File Storage cannot be
associated with any PersistencyFileProxyInterface.fileProxy or Persis-
tencyFileArray.file in an updated manifest, and the update strategy of the
PersistencyFileArray or PersistencyFileProxyInterface corresponding
to the File Storage is delete, the Persistency shall remove the file from the
File Storage.
⌋

[SWS_PER_00395]
⌈

with any PersistencyFileStorageInterface.fileElement or Persistency-
FileStorage.file in an updated manifest, and the update strategy of the Persis-
tencyFileStorage or PersistencyFileStorageInterface corresponding to
the File Storage is delete, the Persistency shall remove the file from the File
Storage.
⌋

FileStorage corresponding to the File Storage is delete, the Persistency
shall remove that file from the File Storage.
⌋

ageInterface.fileElement or PersistencyFileStorage.file in an updated

[SWS_PER_00395]
⌈

ageInterface.fileElement or PersistencyFile in an updated Target Con-
figuration, and the update strategy of the PersistencyFileStorage corre-
sponding to the File Storage is delete/DELETE, the Persistency shall remove
that file from the File Storage.
